title: Move signup email to a background job (example)
prompt: In this Next.js app, sending the welcome email blocks the signup request. Move it to a background job with retries.

title: Persist todos in a real database (example)
prompt: The todos in this app are kept in memory and disappear on restart. Store them in a proper database and add a migration.

title: Add authentication to a FastAPI service (example)
prompt: Add user sign-up and login to this FastAPI service. Users should be able to sign in with Google too.
